title: The Borrowed Compass
author: Marguerite Coldharbour
blurb: Odile Delacroix, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
